evidence: Changes core wallet spending routines in src/wallet/spend.cpp, coin selection, fee bumping, wallet database persistence, and wallet RPCs to support BIP 352 sending.
rationale: This PR adds full wallet support for funding, creating, and fee-bumping transactions to BIP 352 silent payment addresses. As noted in the description, Bitcoin Core cannot currently construct transactions paying to silent payment addresses, preventing users from leveraging receiver privacy and address-reuse prevention. It represents a substantial strategic enhancement to wallet privacy tracked under #28536.
